uses.title: 197 · Rising temperature
uses.snippet:
SELECT w1.id
FROM Weather w1, Weather w2
WHERE DATEDIFF(w1.recordDate, w2.recordDate) = 1 AND w1.temperature > w2.temperature

uses.title: 196 · Delete duplicate emails
uses.snippet:
DELETE p1 FROM Person p1 JOIN Person p2
ON p1.email = p2.email AND p1.id > p2.id;

uses.title: 181 · Employees earning more than their managers
uses.snippet:
SELECT e1.name AS Employee
FROM Employee e1
LEFT JOIN Employee e2 ON e1.managerId = e2.id
WHERE e1.salary > e2.salary

uses.title: 3521 · Find product recommendation pairs
uses.snippet:
p2.product_id AS product2_id
        FROM ProductPurchases p1
        CROSS JOIN ProductPurchases p2
        WHERE p1.user_id = p2.user_id AND p1.product_id < p2.product_id

uses.title: 3580 · Find consistently improving employees
uses.snippet:
l3.rating AS rating3
        FROM LatestReviews l1
        LEFT JOIN LatestReviews l2 ON l1.ranked = l2.ranked - 1

uses.snippet:
